temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose notices Patricia seems more withdrawn than usual at work. When he asks if she is okay, she says it is just personal stuff and thanks him, but does not share details. She appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Before this, Jose believed Patricia was generally vibrant at work and had no known significant troubles.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he moves from seeing no known issue to suspecting Patricia is dealing with a personal problem, while respecting that she is not ready to share details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be struggling with something personal, and she values his support but is not ready to open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and be available to listen without pushing her to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. In conversation, Patricia confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and is open to discussing financial planning or budgeting tips.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia had some personal issue troubling her, though he did not know the cause, and he wanted to support her as a friend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he now connects her withdrawn mood to financial stress and learns she is receptive to practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is financially stressed and overwhelmed, but she may welcome budgeting or financial planning help from him.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Sympathetic concern and worry for her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To discuss financial planning or budgeting tips with her when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose asks whether Patricia minded him bringing up financial planning and clarifies that he wants to help, not pry. Patricia reassures him that she did not think he was prying and says she is grateful for his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia was financially stressed and had seemed open to help, but he worried that his offer might have overstepped her boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; his worry is resolved because Patricia directly reassures him that she did not feel pried into and appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia does not think he overstepped; she appreciates his help, and he can support her while respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially anxious or uncertain, then relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clarify his respectful boundaries and continue being a supportive friend.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks in casually about how things are going and weekend plans. Patricia says everything is all good and that she plans a quiet weekend at home, without sharing more. He senses she appreciates his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Patricia reassured him, Jose believed she did not think he was prying and appreciated his support, while he remained concerned about her personal and financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he refines his understanding: she appreciates his concern but wants privacy and prefers to manage her issues herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values his support, but he should keep his check-ins low-pressure and avoid probing into her private matters.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, with acceptance of her need for privacy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To remain friendly and supportive while giving her space and not pushing for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in and offers help, even if it is just grabbing a coffee. Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believed Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately, so he intended to remain supportive without prying.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Reinforced rather than significantly changed; Patricia confirms she values his supportive presence while managing things independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation and appreciates his regular, low-pressure support; he should continue being available without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Reassured, warm, and satisfied that his support is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain a supportive presence through regular check-ins and practical offers of help, without applying pressure.
